name: Shi YiGuang
source: A citizen of Ng and the next leader of the Shi Clan, the most magically powerful clan in all of the Kingdom of Ng and Yue. As a child, he was FuChai's playmate. He secretly escaped to ZhuLuo Village in the Kingdom of Yue to avoid being sacrificed at the Sword Pond. His medical skills are second to none. He is gentle and kind. His nickname is XiShi.
